- It directly tests whether the aggregation method matters with the superior RNA encoder
- If transformer helps, we've found a better config; if not, we confirm avgpool is optimal
- This reduces uncertainty about an important design choice (aggregation) in the context of the best-performing setup

I'll go with config_009.
